definitions.explanation: Consisting of only one kind, element, or component. Emphasizes uniformity or the absence of variety or complexity.

examples.japanese: {単一|たんいつ}の{基準|きじゅん}で{評価|ひょうか}する。
examples.english: Evaluate based on a single standard.

examples.japanese: {単一|たんいつ}{民族|みんぞく}{国家|こっか}という{考|かんが}え{方|かた}は{正確|せいかく}ではない。
examples.english: The idea of a single-ethnicity nation is not accurate.

examples.japanese: {複数|ふくすう}のシステムを{単一|たんいつ}のプラットフォームに{統合|とうごう}する{計画|けいかく}だ。
examples.english: The plan is to integrate multiple systems into a single platform.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{単一|たんいつ}{民族|みんぞく} (single ethnicity)
・{単一|たんいつ}{通貨|つうか} (single currency)
・{単一|たんいつ}{市場|しじょう} (single market)
・{単一|たんいつ}の{基準|きじゅん} (single standard)

USAGE NOTES:
Used as a の-adjective to modify nouns: {単一|たんいつ}の～ or {単一|たんいつ}～ (without の in compound nouns like {単一|たんいつ}{民族|みんぞく}). Often contrasted with {複数|ふくすう} (multiple) or {多様|たよう} (diverse). More formal than {一|ひと}つの, and emphasizes the concept of uniformity rather than just the number one.
